title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Copilot to make on canvas edits on Pages
description: Bring Copilot into the flow of collaboration on your Page, not just the chat box. Leave comments on your Page to ask Copilot questions or request targeted edits directly, and have people and Copilot work across the Page while seeing their presence and changes
